ABOUT

About The Showplace at Daikin Northeast

Since 1982, the Showplace at Daikin Northeast has been helping homeowners create beautiful, functional spaces. Now located exclusively in Middletown, NY, our showroom continues to uphold a trusted reputation for quality products, expert guidance, and exceptional service. From primary residences to vacation homes, new builds to last-minute updates, our team is here to inspire and support your next project.


Our Services

Our Middletown showroom is designed to support any project, no matter the size, style, or budget. Thoughtfully curated displays and working models help take the guesswork out of product selection, making it easier to envision your space.

Whether you’re just browsing or actively renovating, the Showplace team is ready to assist you or your design and building professionals. Our experienced consultants can guide your project from initial concept to final details, or simply help you choose the perfect fixture to complete your room. With decades of industry experience, we specialize in making projects run smoothly and seamlessly.

We encourage one-on-one consultations to provide personalized recommendations and dedicated support from the moment you walk in.
